mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(ACCOUNT_NUMBER) FROM accounts WHERE account_role = 1;

SELECT t.tag_name AS tagName, ROUND( COUNT(adt.festival_number) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(add_tag_number) FROM add_tags), 0 ) AS percent FROM tags t JOIN add_tags adt ON t.tag_number = adt.tag_number GROUP BY t.tag_name ORDER BY percent DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.TAG_NUMBER AS tagNumber, T.TAG_NAME AS tagName, COUNT(DISTINCT C.ACCOUNT_NUMBER) AS count FROM tags T JOIN choice_tags C ON T.TAG_NUMBER = C.TAG_NUMBER GROUP BY T.TAG_NAME ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT ACCOUNT_NUMBER, NICKNAME, POPULARITY FROM accounts WHERE account_role = 1 ORDER BY POPULARITY ASC LIMIT 5;
